intro.text: A soldier in Highprince Sadeas's warcamp on the Shattered Plains who brings in new bridgemen.

items.text: Laresh worked in the duty tent and brought in recruits to replace bridgemen killed on plateau runs. Early in Kaladin's time as a bridgeman he brought two groups: the first, made up of smugglers, went to another bridge, while he saved the second, a particularly ragtag bunch, for Bridge Four.

appearance.text: A tall man with yellow-and-black hair.

personality.text: He has little sympathy for the bridgemen, joining Gaz in mocking them and saving the worst recruits for Bridge Four.
